title: Beta Mushroom Spreading
description: Reverts Mushroom spreading to how it was in Beta Minecraft
body:
# What Is This?

You probably clicked on this mod wondering what exactly it changes.

In modern versions of Minecraft, Red and Brown Mushrooms will only spread if there are **fewer** than 5 mushrooms of the same type within a 9×9×3 area.

However, in Beta Minecraft *(including the popular Beta 1.7.3)*, this check doesn't exist. Because of that, you would commonly see the Nether *(and sometimes caves too, since they generated with mushrooms back then)* absolutely filled to the brim with mushrooms!

All this mod does is revert that change, allowing mushrooms to spread infinitely just like they did in those old versions.
### *Note:*

*This mod does **not** change how quickly mushrooms spread, only how far they can spread.*
